library(Seurat)
library(ComplexHeatmap)

##Heatmaps

```{r}
obj <- readRDS("../annotated_subset_data.RDS")
genes_select <- c("FABP1","PHGR1","TRDC","KLRC3","GPR15","RAB3GAP1","KLRC2","ATP8B4","IKZF2","TRGC2")
# genes_select <- c("GZMB","IFITM1","SPOCK2","GBP1","NFKBIA","LAG3","CCL4","GBP5","TYMP","GZMK")

#avg expression matrix
get_sample_matrix <- function(obj, genes) {
genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(obj))
expr <- GetAssayData(obj, layer = "data")[genes, , drop = FALSE]
expr <- as.matrix(expr)
samples <- obj@meta.data$sample_names

# keep desired samples
keep <- grepl("^NV|^IBD", samples)
expr <- expr[, keep, drop = FALSE]
samples <- samples[keep]
# unique sample names
sample_order <- unique(samples)
# average expression per sample
mat <- sapply(sample_order, function(s) {
idx <- which(samples == s)
rowMeans(expr[, idx, drop = FALSE])
})

# preserve names
rownames(mat) <- genes
colnames(mat) <- sample_order
# z-score per gene
mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
rownames(mat_z) <- genes
colnames(mat_z) <- sample_order
mat_z
}
##to check
mat_gdt <- get_sample_matrix(obj, genes_select)
dim(mat_gdt)
colnames(mat_gdt)

###now create heatmap
global_max <- max(abs(mat_gdt), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
c(-global_max, 0, global_max),
c("darkblue", "white", "#D4494E")
)
###
h_gdt <- Heatmap(
mat_gdt,

name = "z-score",
col = col_fun,

cluster_rows = FALSE,
cluster_columns = FALSE,

show_row_names = TRUE,
show_column_names = TRUE,

row_names_side = "left",
row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),

column_names_rot = 45,
column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),

column_title = "GDT_subcluster markers",
column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"),

# black borders around cells
rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1),

# make heatmap wider
width = unit(ncol(mat_gdt) * 0.5, "cm"),

heatmap_legend_param = list(
title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)
)
)

draw(
h_gdt,
heatmap_legend_side = "right"
)

```
### bubble plot for specific genes across seurat clusters
```{r}
sc_bubbleplot <- function(
  seu,
  genes,
  group_by = "seurat_clusters",
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data",
  scale_gene = TRUE,
  groups_keep = NULL,
  dot_range = c(0, 8),
  x_expand = c(0.6, 0),
  y_expand = c(0, 0.5),
  sort_condition = NULL,
  sort_weights = c(expr = 1, prop = 1)
){

  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  
  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(seu))
  stopifnot(length(genes) > 1)

  seu <- JoinLayers(seu)
  expr <- GetAssayData(seu, assay = assay, layer = layer)

  dt <- as.data.table(t(expr[genes, ]), keep.rownames = "cell")
  dt[, grpBy := seu@meta.data[[group_by]]]


  if(!is.null(groups_keep)){
    dt <- dt[grpBy %in% groups_keep]
  }

  dt <- melt(
    dt,
    id.vars = c("cell","grpBy"),
    variable.name = "geneName",
    value.name = "val"
  )

  # shinycell aggregation
  dt[, val := expm1(val)]

  ggData <- dt[, .(
    val  = mean(val),
    prop = sum(val > 0) / .N
  ), by = .(geneName, grpBy)]

  ggData[, val := log1p(val)]

  if(scale_gene){
    ggData[, val := scale(val), by = geneName]
  }
  
  mat <- dcast(
  ggData,
  geneName ~ grpBy,
  value.var = "val",
  fill = 0
  )
  
  mat <- as.matrix(mat[, -1])
  rownames(mat) <- unique(ggData$geneName)
  
  # cluster columns
  hc <- hclust(dist(t(mat)), method = "ward.D2")
  cluster_order <- colnames(mat)[hc$order]
  
  # apply order
  ggData[, grpBy := factor(grpBy, levels = cluster_order)]
  
    if (!is.null(sort_condition)) {
  
    stopifnot(sort_condition %in% ggData$grpBy)
  
    gene_order <- ggData[grpBy == sort_condition,
      .(score =
          sort_weights["expr"] * val +
          sort_weights["prop"] * prop),
      by = geneName
    ][order(-score), geneName]
  
    ggData[, geneName := factor(geneName, levels = gene_order)]
  }

  ggplot(ggData, aes(grpBy, geneName)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = val, size = prop),
      shape = 21,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.25
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "proportion",
      range = dot_range,
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "navy", mid = "white", high = "firebrick",
      name = ifelse(scale_gene, "scaled expression", "expression")
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "8"),
                     expand = x_expand) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = y_expand) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 14)
    ) + coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    guides(
      size = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(
          fill = "black",
          color = "black",
          shape = 21,
          stroke = 0.25
        )
      )
    )
}

```


### Bubble plot for specific genes across seurat clusters
```{r}
obj <- readRDS("../annotated_subset_clusters.RDS")
markers <- c(
"IL32", "TNFRSF9", "IFNG", "AREG", "KLRF1", "LGALS4", "EPCAM", "IL17A", "TXNIP", "HLA-DRB1", "GZMK", "JUN","CD48", "KLRC3","KIR2DL4")

p <- sc_bubbleplot(
  seu = obj,
  genes = markers,
  group_by = "seurat_clusters",
  groups_keep = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "8"),  
  scale_gene = TRUE,
  x_expand = c(0.1, 0)
)

print(p)

```
### Bar plots for gene expression across conditions

```{r}

genes <- c("GPR15")#GPR15#C10orf99
data_reannotated <- readRDS("../primary_clusters.RDS")
expr_mat <- FetchData(data_reannotated, vars = c(genes, "condition"))
expr_long <- expr_mat %>% pivot_longer(cols = all_of(genes), names_to = "gene", values_to = "expression")

bar_df <- expr_long %>% group_by(condition, gene) %>% summarise(mean_expr = mean(expression), .groups = "drop")

stat_loc <- expr_long %>% 
  group_by(gene) %>% 
  summarise(p = wilcox.test(expression ~ condition)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"), 
         stars = ifelse(p_adj < 0.001, "***", ifelse(p_adj < 0.01, "**", ifelse(p_adj < 0.05, "*", "ns"))), 
         p_txt = ifelse(p_adj < 1e-300, "p < 1e-300", paste0("p = ", signif(p_adj, 3))), 
         label = paste0(stars, "\n", p_txt))

# bracket spans the two condition bars
brack <- stat_loc %>% mutate(xmin = 1, xmax = 2, x = 1.5, top = max(bar_df$mean_expr), y = top * 1.06, yend = top * 1.11)

p1 <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = factor(condition), y = mean_expr, fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.65) +
  geom_segment(data = brack, aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = yend, yend = yend), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(data = brack, aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin, y = y, yend = yend), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(data = brack, aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = yend), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = brack, aes(x = x, y = yend, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3, lineheight = 0.9, vjust = -0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Healthy" = "#457B9D", "UC" = "#E63946")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.22))) +
  labs(x = "condition", y = "Mean expression", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9), axis.title = element_text(size = 10), legend.position = "top", legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 9), legend.spacing.x = unit(0.2, "cm"), plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6))
p1
```

#Forest Plot for CLR cell freq

```{r}
# Read csv for plotting
diff_df <- read_excel("../subset_UC_vs_Healthy.xlsx")
#Compact forest plot
p <- ggplot(diff_df,
       aes(
         x = estimate,
         y = cluster,
         color = condition
       )) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = lower.CL, xmax = upper.CL),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.55),
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.55),
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = upper.CL + 0.25,  # Move text further right
      label = est_label,
      group = condition
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.55),
    vjust = 0.3,  # Align lower with the center of geom_point
    size = 5,  # Maintain text size
    color = "black",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "UC" = "#D4494E"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Cluster-wise CLR differences relative to Healthy",
    y = "Clusters",
    color = "condition",
    title = "Cluster-wise Counts Comparison"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.001, 0.001))  # Further reduce whitespace
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(from = -100, to = 100, by = 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +  # Add padding below lines
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5),  
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),  
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),  
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),  
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15), 
    legend.position = "bottom",  
    legend.box = "horizontal", 
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),  
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),  
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black")  
  )

p <- p + theme(text = element_text(family = "sans",size = 12))

print(p)
```
